Karnataka Police Constable Dies by Suicide in Patrol Vehicle

A 30-year-old police constable from the City Armed Reserve allegedly died by suicide by shooting himself with his service rifle inside a stationary police patrol van in Kalaburagi, Karnataka. The incident occurred at the busy Jagat Circle. Initial investigations suggest personal reasons and mental stress, though police are examining all angles.
